app.title: Runly Settings
neverAskWarning:
With this setting, every script you double-click runs without any prompt. Files downloaded
from the internet still show a warning. Continue?
selectRow: Select a row to see its details here.
extension.blockedAdd: Runly cannot manage this extension because of Windows security and system integrity.
select.added: {extension} was added to the list and selected. Now choose an application.
select.notFound: {extension} was not found in the list.
handler.notSelected: No application is selected for this extension.
handler.notSelectedDetail:
No application has been chosen for `{extension}` yet.

Double-click the row or use the **{button}** button.

After choosing, press **Install / Update** to bind it.
chooseApp.title: Choose application
chooseApp.empty: No applications found. Use Browse to pick an .exe.
chooseApp.pickOne: Select an application from the list.
chooseApp.noRow: Select an extension row in the table first.
chooseApp.assigned: {extension} → {app} selected. Press Install / Update to bind it.
bind.needsInstall:
{extension} has not been registered with Windows yet, so it does not appear on the Windows default apps page.

Choosing an application only writes Runly's own setting; Windows needs the installation step to learn about the extension.

Install it now and open Windows settings?
bind.notRegistered:
{extension} could not be registered with Windows even after installing.

The usual cause is that the row's application cannot be found, or the row is not enabled. Enable the extension and choose the application again.
